intro: The Saphan Khwai–Ari area around Paolo Hospital Phahon Yothin is very easy to get around if the hospital is your reason for the trip. The hospital sits right on Phahonyothin Road in front of Saphan Khwai market, about a 3-minute walk from BTS Saphan Khwai Exit 2. Most hotels are spread around the station and the near end of Phahonyothin, so you can reach the hospital gate in a few minutes. Nearby you'll find convenience stores, a fresh market, restaurants, and pharmacies, so food is easy to find all day. It suits patient families, people in for a check-up, and outpatients making frequent trips. If you want somewhere quieter with more of a cafe vibe, move one station over toward Ari. The BTS also carries you straight on to Siam or Victory Monument.

blocks.html: Short answer: Paolo Hospital Phahon Yothin sits right on Phahonyothin Road in front of BTS Saphan Khwai (Exit 2, about a 3-minute walk), and plenty of hotels are within a few hundred metres on foot. For a budget room you can still walk to the hospital from, look at NewYork Suite Hotel or Suda Palace (from about ฿700–900). For a newer hotel with a pool, try SureStay by Best Western Iconic Ari-Jatujak or BLU 395 (from about ฿1,300–1,400). For a 4-star with a view over toward Ari, The Quarter Ari by UHG starts around ฿2,000 a night.

items.name: BLU 395 Ari-Saphan Khwai
items.meta: 📍 3-min walk (250 m) to Paolo Phahon Yothin · ★ 3-star · Best for: Walk to the hospital · good value · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: Right on the main road, no need to walk into a small soi, about 250 metres from Paolo and a few minutes to the hospital gate. It's a small hotel of around 29 rooms, with a microwave and flat-screen TV in the room, plus laundry and a front desk. Reviews sit around 8.3, praising the location by BTS Saphan Khwai and the value. Good for outpatients and families who want to be close without paying much.

items.name: SureStay by Best Western Iconic Ari-Jatujak
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (400 m) to Paolo Phahon Yothin · ★ 4-star · Best for: Has a pool · chain hotel · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A Best Western chain hotel of around 157 rooms in the Sutthisan area next to Saphan Khwai, about 400 metres from Paolo. It has an outdoor pool, a gym, a rooftop restaurant, and a cafe. Reviews around 8.2 praise the cleanliness and service. Suits families and anyone who wants chain-hotel standards and full facilities at a reasonable rate.

items.name: Chatuchak Haus
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (400 m) to Paolo Phahon Yothin · ★ 3-star · Best for: Apartment-style rooms · quiet · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An apartment-style stay in the Saphan Khwai area, about 400 metres from Paolo, with roomy units, a large bed, and a good shower, and a quieter feel than the roadside hotels. Reviews sit around 8.5. A fit for anyone who wants a quiet private room within walking distance of the hospital. One thing to know: the entrance can be a little hard to find, so check the pin or brief your driver first.

items.name: Suda Palace
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (400 m) to Paolo Phahon Yothin · ★ 3-star · Best for: Budget · multi-bed rooms · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A long-running hotel of around 196 rooms in Saphan Khwai, about a 5-minute walk from Paolo and the BTS. Its strong point is 3-to-4-bed rooms, handy for a large family who wants to stay together cheaply. Reviews around 7.4 note the value and location. Rooms are basic, so it's best for those focused on budget and a short walk to the hospital.

items.name: NewYork Suite Hotel
items.meta: 📍 4-min walk (300 m) to Paolo Phahon Yothin · ★ 3-star · Best for: Lowest budget · short stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The cheapest option in the area, about 300 metres from Paolo and a quick walk to the hospital gate. Rooms have air-con, a flat-screen TV, and a fridge, some with a balcony, plus a minimart and a 24-hour front desk. The building is fairly old and reviews are mixed. Best for anyone who just wants a cheap bed near the hospital for a short stay, not a fancy one.

items.name: The Quarter Ari by UHG
items.meta: 📍 1 BTS stop · 12-min walk (950 m) to Paolo Phahon Yothin · ★ 4-star · Best for: 4-star · nice view · longer stays · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 4-star hotel on Phahonyothin in the Ari district, about 950 metres from Paolo, or one BTS stop from Saphan Khwai to Ari. It has a pool and poolside bar on the 33rd floor with a good city view, and rooms come with a fridge and microwave. Reviews are high at around 8.7–8.9, praising the cleanliness and staff. A fit for anyone who wants a step-up hotel for a longer stay and doesn't mind a slightly longer walk or a quick BTS hop.

items.name: Siam Palace Hotel
items.meta: 📍 5-min walk (400 m) to Paolo Phahon Yothin · ★ 3-star · Best for: Good value · near Saphan Khwai BTS · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda

Rooms are simple and clean at a modest price, and it's near Saphan Khwai market and Big C so food is easy to find. Good for patient families and people in for a check-up who want a value stay they can walk to the hospital from, no extra ride needed.

faq.q: Are there hotels within walking distance of Paolo Hospital Phahon Yothin?
faq.a: Yes, several. The hospital is right on Phahonyothin Road in front of BTS Saphan Khwai, and most hotels around the station reach the gate in a few minutes. BLU 395 is about 250 metres away, while NewYork Suite Hotel, Suda Palace, and Chatuchak Haus are roughly 300–400 metres, all an easy walk.

faq.q: How do I get to Paolo Phahon Yothin from Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faq.a: The easiest way is a taxi, about 40–60 minutes depending on traffic. To avoid traffic, take the Airport Rail Link from Suvarnabhumi to Phaya Thai, change to the BTS Sukhumvit line, and get off at Saphan Khwai, then use Exit 2 and walk about 3 minutes to the front of the hospital.

faq.q: Which hotel near Paolo has a swimming pool?
faq.a: If you want a pool and a newer room, SureStay by Best Western Iconic Ari-Jatujak is about 400 metres away with an outdoor pool and a gym, from around ฿1,400. If you don't mind a slightly longer walk toward Ari, The Quarter Ari by UHG is a 4-star with a 33rd-floor pool and a nice view, from around ฿2,000 a night.
